tool: MetaHuman Creator in Unreal Engine 5.8 (MetaHumanCharacter plugin), scripted through the editor MCP server
license: Unreal Engine EULA (MetaHumans are covered by the Unreal Engine EULA from UE 5.6; no separate MetaHuman licence). See https://www.metahuman.com/license and https://www.unrealengine.com/eula
licenseNotes: Free under the standard Unreal Engine terms; the Unreal Engine royalty applies above USD 1M gross revenue per product.
The EULA restricts using MetaHuman characters or animation data to train or feed generative AI. Do not do that with these assets.

source.startingPreset: Epic MetaHuman Creator preset, then scripted edits in Content/Python/homestead_agent/metahuman_look.py (HEROINE_LOOK, HEROINE_SCULPT)
source.rig: Epic MetaHuman cloud auto-rigging, JOINTS_AND_BLEND_SHAPES, requested from the editor with Jenny's Epic sign-in
source.textures: Epic MetaHuman cloud texture sources at 4K (RES4K on all eight maps)
source.grooms: Epic stock grooms: Hair_L_Straight, Eyebrows_M_SlightArch, Eyelashes_L_ThickCurl
source.outfit: Epic stock MetaHuman default garment (shirt and shorts), placeholder until the rustic starter outfit (task 4.3/7.3)
source.assembly: build_meta_human, UE Optimized / High, output /Game/Characters/Heroine_MH/Assembled and /Common

animation.clips: /Game/Characters/Heroine_MH/Animations/AN_HeroineMH_* (idle, walk, sprint, gather, water, chop, knife cut, till)
animation.origin: Retargeted from the project's own legacy heroine clips (see docs/asset-credits.md, Character prototype) with IK_HeroineLegacy -> Epic IK_MH_IKRig via RTG_HeroineLegacy_To_MH
animation.retargetOps: Pelvis Motion, FK Chains, Remap Curves. Run IK Rig and Root Motion are disabled because they broke the pose.
